name: CrowdSec (Local API)
param_style: ent v0.14 (sqlgraph) on mattn/go-sqlite3: ? positional, backtick-quoted identifiers, LIMIT/OFFSET inlined, eager loading as separate IN queries; time.Time bound as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff+00:00' text
schema_source: ent's own SQLite DDL: database.NewClient() -> client.Schema.Create() (Atlas) on an empty file, dumped with .schema; generated from pkg/database/ent/migrate/schema.go
data_scale: scale 1: 5 machines, 12 bouncers (4 never pulled), 50k alerts over 8 days (49.8k local from 5 agents with 300 repeat-offender IPs taking ~30 %, 84 cscli imports, 84 CAPI pulls, 13 firehol list pulls), ~196k decisions (~92 % expired; a 1500-entry blocklist re-imported every 2h gives ~84 rows per value, the #4613 shape; latest CAPI alert holds 6000), ~100k events, ~86k metas, 40 allowlist items, 2000 usage metrics; ~160 MB
visibility_note: 15k stars; the open-source IPS behind a large community blocklist network; SQLite is the default LAPI database
interest_note: ent-generated correlated EXISTS / NOT EXISTS chains on the alert list (include_capi), a NOT EXISTS self-anti-join for decision dedup on every bouncer stream page, LIMIT/OFFSET pagination with no index on the sort key, IP-range containment on signed 64-bit encoded addresses, every-minute flush deletes with NOT EXISTS guards.
reach_note: widely self-hosted on servers, routers (OPNsense/pfSense) and k8s; SQLite is the default for the LAPI

cpu_evidence.summary: GET /v1/alerts?limit=0&since=24h stuck in sqlite3_step for 3h+ pinning a core on an 11.5 MB database with CAPI alerts carrying thousands of decisions (v1.7.8, SQLite/WAL)

/v1/decisions/stream for a bouncer with last_pull NULL scans every expired decision through the dedup self-anti-join: 26-37 min at ~700 % CPU with ~2.2M decisions rows (~50k active); one 30k-row page 45 s to >120 s vs ~1 s bounded
v1.7.8 paged decision stream doubles to quadruples LAPI CPU (18 % -> 40 % with 5 bouncers; ~100 % on a Raspberry Pi 4 with database-is-locked errors)

analyze_note: CrowdSec never runs ANALYZE; production LAPIs have no sqlite_stat1 (see #4613), so run.py skips it too.
